svg.title: One action, many worlds, each with its own laws
svg.text: EACH WORLD FOLLOWS ITS OWN LAWS
MLM reads the action as Phrase DNA. ACM predicts its consequence in each world, by that world's laws.

Consequences become the new state of the world
sale, a strike or a new law.
